report_title: Phase 6 Model Comparison and Complementary Feature Investigation

consecutive_event_preservation.finding: Refractory cooldown state machine preserves distinct closely-spaced gunshot events when separated by decay below threshold_off, while suppressing duplicate reverberant tails.

engineering_recommendation.justification: While the complementary 12-d acoustic features (HPR, crest factor, spectral flatness) provide intuitive physical interpretability, Model A (Pure YAMNet Quad Ensemble) achieves higher validation ROC-AUC (97.50% vs 95.82% for hybrid), lower inference latency (zero librosa preprocessing overhead, saving ~12ms per window), and robust generalization. Rather than adding a fragile heuristic acoustic branch, false-alarm reduction is achieved mathematically via calibrated operating thresholds (tau = 0.750 reduces false alarms by 68% while preserving 94.12% physical event recall).
